readyEvidence.meaning: P14-09 defines required Android 12 and Android 15+ device classes, required fields, reserved archive rows, and current blockers.

The v1.3 provider promotion contracts keep overlay at provider_poc until connected device, packaged APK, disclosure, rollback, security, TypeScript, docs, Safe downgrade, and raw-object-denial evidence are closed.
Overlay still requires user-visible disclosure, foreground notification ownership, stop action, disable flag, diagnostics, rollback proof, and crash circuit breaker evidence before promotion.
P15-06 is owned by the pro UI/overlay lane as device_oem_matrix evidence with the overlay rollback hook.
